info.title: OpenCard EMS API
info.description: API for Expense Management Systems. Manage TPAs, organizations, card holders, and webhooks. Receive transaction data via webhooks — not by polling this API.

200.description: OAuth client. `secret` is null — the plaintext secret is only returned on create and regenerate.

put.description: Update `name` and replace `scopes`. `organization_id` and `secret` cannot be changed here — regenerate the secret with the dedicated endpoint.

post.description: Returns a new plaintext `secret` once. The previous secret stops working immediately.
Creates TPA, fetches registry data, generates legal text.

get.description: The signed PDF generated after all required signatories have signed.

404.description: TPA or signed document not found

put.description: Only while `signed` is false. Changing the signatory resends the signing email.

delete.description: Only an unsigned signatory can be removed.

get.description: Physical persons already identified on this TPA.

201.description: Billing created — store `id` as `billing_id` for the organization

put.description: Same fields as create. Turning a product flag off returns 400 when an organization on this billing still has a webhook that needs it: `product_transaction` for `card_transaction_*`, `product_digital_receipt` for `receipt_fetched` and `transaction_true_vat`, `product_aland_index` for `aland_index`.

400.description: A product flag is still required by a linked organization's webhook

example.message: Billing product transaction is required in one or more organizations

get.description: Platform catalog of payment products you can enable. Pick an `id`, then [enable it on your account](#tag/Payment-Products/operation/enablePaymentProduct). Optional `q` searches name, subtitle, and program name. Optional `funding` filters `debit` or `credit`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Space-separated search tokens matched against product name, subtitle, and program name

data.name: Acme Corporate Card
data.subtitle: Corporate Card
data.description_short: Streamline expense management with real-time card data.
data.description_long: Full product description shown after the client activates this card program.

get.description: Payment products already enabled on your account (what clients can pick in onboarding). Same optional filters as the catalog: `q` searches name, subtitle, and program name; `funding` filters `debit` or `credit`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Space-separated search tokens matched against product name, subtitle, and program name

data.name: Acme Corporate Card
data.subtitle: Corporate Card
data.description_short: Streamline expense management with real-time card data.
data.description_long: Full product description shown after the client activates this card program.

example.name: Acme Corporate Card
example.subtitle: Corporate Card
example.description_short: Streamline expense management with real-time card data.
example.description_long: Full product description shown after the client activates this card program.

post.description: Enable a payment product from the [catalog](#tag/Payment-Products/operation/listPaymentProducts) on your account. Empty body. `201` on success; `400` if already enabled.

example.error: Payment product is already enabled on the account.

put.description: Update `reference_id`, `name`, `tpa_id`, `billing_id`, or the card-type flags. The response does not include `billing_id` — read it back with GET.

delete.description: Deletes the organization and cascades its webhooks and card holders.

get.description: Paginated list. Each item includes `identity` (`name`, `employee_id`) when linked — no separate identities call needed for display.

post.description: Create a card holder with `email`. OpenCard sends a PDPC link. Transactions start after the person signs with eID (`card_holder.identified`).

put.description: `reference_id` is required. `email` is optional — omit to keep the current value (including null for identity-linked holders). Resends PDPC email only when unsigned/no identity, `skip_pdpc_email` is false, and an email address exists. Duplicate `reference_id` within the organization returns 400.

example.error: Card holder reference employee_john_42 already exists

put.description: Same body as create. Changing `url` runs the challenge handshake again.

post.description: Posts a sample payload for `event` to the webhook URL. The webhook must already be `active`.

400.description: Webhook is not active, or the event name is unknown

get.description: Extra headers OpenCard sends on every delivery to this webhook.
Buyer-party filters. When groups exist, only matching transactions are delivered to this webhook.

include.description: Comma-separated list of extras to include: line_items, environmental_impact

scopes.webhook-headers-write: Create and update custom webhook headers

language.description: TPA legal text language. `sv` or `en`. If omitted, Sweden defaults to `sv`; other countries default to `en`.

reference_id.description: Your internal client ID — echoed in every webhook for this organization

billing_id.description: Billing profile `id` from `POST .../billings`. Required for webhooks with transaction, receipt or Åland index events — the webhook is validated against the billing's `product_*` flags.

email.description: Where the PDPC signing link is sent

CardHolderUpdate.description: Update card holder. Only `reference_id` is required; other fields are optional.

CardHolderIdentity.description: Linked identity summary on list responses. Only `name` and `employee_id` — nothing else.

employee_id.description: Employee ID on the TPA client

email_invoice.description: Where the OpenCard invoice is sent

your_reference_invoice.description: Your reference printed on the invoice

product_transaction.description: Enables `card_transaction_*` webhook events on organizations linked to this billing

PaymentProduct.description: A card product clients can activate — debit or credit under a payment program.

id.description: Payment product ID. Pass this as `payment_product_id` on `POST .../tpas`.
Payment program ID (same as product `id` until the tables are split)

name.description: Program name shown after the client selects the product

BillingUpdate.description: Fields to change. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

email_invoice.description: Where the OpenCard invoice is sent

your_reference_invoice.description: Your reference printed on the invoice

product_transaction.description: Enables `card_transaction_*` webhook events on organizations linked to this billing

OrganizationUpdate.description: Fields to change. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

process_card_type_corporate.description: Deliver transactions for corporate cards invoiced to the company

process_card_type_corporate_with_private.description: Deliver transactions for corporate cards invoiced to the card holder

process_card_type_private.description: Deliver transactions for private cards invoiced to the card holder

scopes.description: Replaces the client's scopes when present

buyer_party_sub_id.description: Buyer party (organization number) this webhook should receive transactions for
